verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is explicitly built as a live cap table system covering share classes, certificates, SAFEs/convertibles, and option grants (docs-6, 18, 22, 29-35, 36), with investor/employee portals and admin controls (docs-14, 46) supporting reliance by investors, and features like 409A valuations and reporting for auditor-facing needs (docs-8, 20). missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration (e.g., customer case studies or reviews) confirming investors/auditors actually rely on it as source of truth, and explicit audit-trail/versioning documentation.
